title: Order Line Details
description:
Join three tables to produce a full order line report: customer name, product name, quantity, and line total (quantity × unit_price).

**Table: customers** — `id`, `name`, `email`, `city`, `country`

**Table: orders** — `id`, `customer_id`, `order_date`, `status`, `total_amount`

**Table: order_items** — `id`, `order_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `unit_price`

**Table: products** — `id`, `name`, `category`, `price`, `stock_quantity`

Output columns: `customer_name`, `product_name`, `quantity`, `line_total`. Order by `customer_name`, `product_name`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE customers (id INT, name VARCHAR, email VARCHAR, city VARCHAR, country VARCHAR); INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1,'Alice','alice@example.com','New York','USA'),(2,'Bob','bob@example.com','London','UK'); CREATE TABLE orders (id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, status VARCHAR, total_amount DECIMAL); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1,DATE '2026-01-10','completed',1299.98),(2,2,DATE '2026-01-12','completed',699.99); CREATE TABLE order_items (id INT, order_id INT, product_id INT, quantity INT, unit_price DECIMAL); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (1,1,1,1,999.99),(2,1,3,1,299.99),(3,2,2,1,699.99); CREATE TABLE products (id INT, name VARCHAR, category VARCHAR, price DECIMAL, stock_quantity INT); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Laptop','Electronics',999.99,10),(2,'Phone','Electronics',699.99,25),(3,'Desk','Furniture',299.99,5);
solution_sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, p.name AS product_name, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS line_total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY customer_name, product_name

test_cases.description: Alice has Desk and Laptop; Bob has Phone

hints: Chain JOINs: customers → orders → order_items → products.
explanation: Each JOIN adds one more table to the result. customers→orders links customers to their orders; orders→order_items expands to individual line items; order_items→products resolves product names. `quantity * unit_price` gives the line total.
